question: Lionel Messi, one of the winners of the ‘Laurel Sportsman of the Year 2020’, plays football for:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Argentina**__.

__
 
• **Lionel Messi, one of the winners of the ‘Laurel Sportsman of the Year 2020’, plays football for Argentina.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lionel Messi:**

 
 
• He is an Argentine footballer and plays as a forward for **Ligue 1 club Paris Saint-Germain.**
 
• He is** **also the** **captain of the** Argentina national team. **
 
• He has won a record six **Ballon d'Or awards.**
 
• In 2020, he became the **first footballer to win the Laureus World Sportsman of the Year award. **
 
• He is also the first athlete to win it coming from a team sport.
 
 
 
• **Laureus World Sports Awards**
 
 
• It is an annual award ceremony honouring individuals and teams from the world of sports.
 
• The award was established in **1999 **by **Laureus Sport for Good Foundation** whose founding patrons were** Daimler and Richemont. **
